npcs.name: Sturge Gearhand
npcs.description: Sturge Gearhand is a Vedalken machinist with a calm voice, clever hands, and the rare gift of making broken people trust broken machines again. He builds pumps, beds, generators, barricades, and improvised defenses for the Freeblade Veil, treating every safe wall and warm lamp as proof that survival can become a home. Sturge rarely discusses his own origins, and the more someone knows about construct-soul work, the more careful they become around his old scars and too-neat memory gaps.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Cloverfen is a Town in Eldermere, under Cooperative Commonwealth, with low danger, Farming, Grassland, Hybrid tree and forest floor terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Vedalken reads through the Vedalken entry of the race compendium, within Miscellaneous and Hard-to-Classify Races, marked by Nephthysra. Coldly rational, blue-skinned intellect-focused beings who prioritize logic and perfection. They often suppress emotion in favor of disciplined thought and experimentation. Table cues: +2 Intelligence, +1 Wisdom, Vedalken Dispassion, Tireless Precision; starting tendency Neutral - Lawful - Neutral - Honorable.
rumors: Sturge can build a settlement beacon from scrap, prayer, and an insulted kettle.
Some Glasswell Institute records describe a missing prototype with hands exactly like his.
plotHooks: Sturge asks the party to salvage machine parts from a ruin that recognizes him by a name he denies knowing.
A settlement defense works too well, revealing Sturge built it from restricted Directorate schematics.
